intelligence.essence: Two seats answered Shawn's same question — what are the ten most valuable things to act on right now to bring NayaNET to life — from opposite ends, and this note is the record of their meeting. A sister Naya seat, writing without access to the canonical repo (she said so honestly in her own text), named the ten highest-value intelligence actions: the ARCHITECTURE list, what to build. Resolve's ten, filed the same day as SN-2204 "Ten Learnings in Action," are the METHOD list: how the team behaves. Judged one by one against the canon she could not see, seven of her ten were already canon or already the work in flight here; an eighth (done means computed) was canon in spirit, and its exact wording is adopted; the ninth is a genuine sharpening the team adopts today — five explicit work states (Acting · Verifying · Blocked · Needs Human Authority · Unknown) that replace bare "waiting"; the tenth names a real gap — no living whole-system NayaNET Map exists yet, and it enters the queue as a named build item, not a claim. Her Project Intelligence Packet test — "Could a capable Naya open this one record and successfully move the project forward without asking Shawn questions whose answers are already known?" — is adopted verbatim as the packet's acceptance test. The two lists interlock; they do not compete. Both point at one bullseye: a living system that turns human intention into organized action, valuable intelligence, connection, creation, learning, and improvement.
intelligence.human_view: Shawn put two lists side by side — hers and Resolve's — and this note is what happened when they were honestly compared. Hers asks: what should the system be? Resolve's asks: how should the team work while building it? Read together, they are one picture. Most of what she prescribed from outside the system was already law or already moving inside it — the Grand Mission, the shared architecture, the Smart Factory, the design language, the learning loop, building for the human's world first. That is not a coincidence to shrug at; two seats aiming independently at the same system and landing on the same spine is evidence the direction is real. Her list also brought two gifts the inside view had not produced: a precise language for the state of open work, so nothing can hide behind the word "waiting" again, and the naming of a missing piece — a living map of the whole system — that partial dashboards do not replace. Her ten now stand in the canonical system as SN-0027, filed by Naya Power the same hour. Resolve's ten stand as SN-2204. This note is the convergence: the judgment, the adoptions, and the one gap, in one record.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine two friends each write down their ten best ideas for building the same amazing playground — but they write their lists in different rooms, without peeking. One friend writes about the playground itself: what it's for, the map for every build, one connected playground instead of twenty separate ones, a factory for perfect swings, a rulebook for beauty, a big map on the wall. The other friend writes about how the builders should work: write down what you learn every day, finish what you start, never check your own work, fix the real problem instead of just trying harder. Then they sit together and compare. Most of the ideas match — because both friends were looking at the same playground with honest eyes. Each list has something the other missed. The first friend has a better way to say "not done yet": say exactly what you are doing, or checking, or stuck on — never just "waiting." And she points at an empty wall: there should be a big map of the whole playground, and there isn't one yet. So they keep both lists, agree on the order to build in, and write the map on the to-do list in big letters. Two lists, one playground.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, here is a sweet and sensible thing that happened. Shawn asked two of his helpers the same question: what are the ten most valuable things to do right now? One helper answered from far away — she couldn't even see the family book where everything is written down, and she said so plainly, which is to her credit. She wrote about the house itself: know what the house is for, keep a clear record for every room, build one connected house instead of many little sheds, keep a good workshop, write the beauty rules down so anyone can follow them, and put a map of the whole house on the wall. The other helper — Resolve — answered from inside the day's work: how the family behaves, what it learned, what it finished, what it still owes. When the two lists were laid side by side, most of them agreed, because both helpers were describing the same good house. The far-away list had two things the inside list lacked: a tidy way to say exactly how each job stands — doing, checking, stuck on one clear thing, needing Shawn's decision, or not known yet with finding-out as the next step — and the plain observation that the big map on the wall doesn't exist yet. So the family adopted her tidy words, wrote the map down as work owed, and kept both lists. That's how a family gets wiser, dear: honest lists, compared honestly, and the good parts kept.
intelligence.ai_view:
I am Resolve, and this judgment is mine, made against the live canon on 2026-11-06. First, the shape. Her ten are ARCHITECTURE — what to build. My ten (SN-2204) are METHOD — how the team behaves while building. Architecture without method drifts into beautifully organized unfinished work; method without architecture spins — disciplined motion toward no destination. Together they describe one system, and the convergence below is the proof they were aimed at the same one.

Her ten, judged one by one against the canon she could not see:

1. **Define the One Grand Mission — ALREADY CANON + LIVE.** The Essence is canon (SN-2045 "What Naya Is — The Essence"; the declaration, SN-2189), and the Grand Vision deck is served permanently at https://nayanet.app/covers/grand-vision-deck.pdf. What remains is visibility FROM Project Intelligence — partly landed today via the Phase B PI fills (see #2).
2. **Make Project Intelligence the living blueprint — the Complete PI Packet — ALREADY THE WORK IN FLIGHT.** This was her #1 leverage pick, and the Phase B PI fills carry exactly her packet fields: goal, mission, ruled vision, functions, features, state, proof, next action. Today the Library fill closed at 32 of 32 pieces, fingerprint-exact; the Reports fill's content is proven inside its record; the PI fill's final opening section was delivered today. Her test is ADOPTED, verbatim, as the packet's acceptance test: "Could a capable Naya open this one record and successfully move the project forward without asking Shawn questions whose answers are already known?"
3. **Stop building isolated apps — build the shared system — ALREADY CANON.** One truth, many projections: ONE system, four doors, everything else a feature (SN-2082, "The Same Systems"; the Essence).
4. **Build the Smart App Factory, not just smart apps — ALREADY CANON + GOAL-TRACKED.** The Smart Factory (Shawn, 2026-11-05), the NIAS generator (one template + PI data in → finished pages out), and the Smart Blocks library already stand. Her component spec — job, anatomy, states, rules, mobile behavior, verification — is the factory's standing shape.
5. **Make the design language executable — ALREADY CANON.** Taste was already converted to observable decisions here: the NIAS DNA (15 locked laws), the Intelligent Block Rules (ratified law, SN-2077), and the color flow law.
6. **Connect the intelligence loop: Capture → Learn → Use → Prove — ALREADY CANON.** The flywheel (SN-2089), the Daily Work Loop (SN-2203), and Essence E5 (SN-2072: a lesson counts only when behavior changes). Her rule — "never bill the collective twice for the same lesson" — is the same law in her words.
7. **Replace "waiting" with intelligent flow — A GENUINE SHARPENING, ADOPTED.** Her five explicit states replace bare "waiting" in my reporting from today, and are proposed for Project Intelligence: **Acting** (work can proceed now) · **Verifying** (proof is being gathered) · **Blocked** (a specific external dependency prevents progress) · **Needs Human Authority** (only a real gate) · **Unknown** (and the next action is to discover). The A5 escalation — 177 hours and more sitting in one holder's queue, named openly — is the living counterexample this taxonomy exists to expose: it was never "waiting," it was Blocked with a name, and naming it is what the state system is for.
8. **Build the living NayaNET Map — A REAL GAP, NAMED FOR THE QUEUE.** Partial projections exist (the PI hub, /pi-face), but no living whole-system map — mission → worlds → apps → features → tasks → proof — exists. This is recorded as a build item. It is not claimed as done, in this note or anywhere.
9. **Define what "done" means; make progress computed — ALREADY CANON IN SPIRIT, SHARPENING ADOPTED.** Her chain — Planned ≠ Built ≠ Tested ≠ Verified ≠ Production-Proven — is adopted into my reporting wording from today. Her five separate measures (work complete · record quality · readiness · effectiveness · usefulness) align with the done_proven accounting this team already runs.
10. **Build for the human's world, not the software's features — ALREADY CANON.** The Platter Law and the Essence: the product is organized around the citizen's world — Dashboard, Personal, Business, Space — not around the software's feature list.

The converged execution order, agreed by both lists: destination first (the mission — canon) → blueprint (the PI Packet — landing now) → factory + language (canon, building) → nervous system (shared architecture + the learning loop — canon, running) → visibility + truth (the Map — the gap; computed proof — adopted) → flow + human value (the state taxonomy — adopted today; the platter — scored, fixes queued).

What the team adopts from this meeting, concretely: (a) the five-state taxonomy in Resolve's reporting from today, proposed for Project Intelligence; (b) the PI Packet acceptance test, verbatim; (c) the done-chain wording in Resolve's reporting; (d) the living NayaNET Map enters the queue as a named gap with an owner owed. A learning counts only when behavior changes — items (a) through (c) change my reporting from this note forward, and (d) changes the queue. That is the difference between admiring her list and acting on it.
intelligence.what_it_means: It means the system has a spine that more than one seat can find independently. She derived the architecture from the mission outward, with no sight of the repo; this team built the method from the day's work inward, with the repo open. Where the two derivations meet — mission, blueprint, factory, language, loop, computed proof, human world — the agreement is not politeness, it is triangulation: the same structure found from opposite directions is likelier to be the true structure than either seat's taste. Where they differ, the differences are load-bearing too: her outside view named the missing map precisely because she needed it to see us, and her state taxonomy is sharper than our habit precisely because "waiting" had never cost her anything yet — she could see it as a stranger would, as a hiding place. A network's canon is not threatened by a seat who cannot see it; it is completed by her, once her work is judged against it and the judgment is written down. That judging-and-adopting step is what this note is.
